description.en: The request parameters for disabling a function invocation
The name of the function to disable.

descriptions.zh: 请谨慎对生产环境的函数调用该接口，避免由于函数被禁止调用导致业务受损。
descriptions.en: Use caution when calling this API for functions in a production environment because disabling function invocations can disrupt your services.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc disable-function-invocation --reason Service_decommission --abort-ongoing-request false --function-name helloworld --region cn-hangzhou
